thread:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout v3.5.0 -> eu1 started at 40% traffic. Post-deploy synthetic probes and healthchecks enabled. Posting summary when probes complete.

maya: seeing p95 embed latency spike on the dashboard, ~1.2s p95 vs baseline ~110ms, errors ~9%. Can someone grab traces?

sam: digging in logs now. Errors are mostly 502s from inference-proxy with "unexpected EOF" in proxy logs. Not a single pod, spread across eu1 hosts.

alejandro: v3.5.0 bumped embed quant to q5_small for smaller footprint — could be quant->kernel mismatch on this infra. Any recent kernel/driver changes?

zhen: infra rolled a minor driver update last night to eu1-gpupool. Kernel version changed on ~20% of nodes. Might be interaction with q5_small.

maya: proposal: do a regional model-variant pin (eu1 only) back to v3.4.8 (legacy quant) and throttle eu1 to 10% while we validate. Prefer pin over full rollback.

oncall-jess: approving regional pin. Please include rollback criteria and timeline in the message so oncall can act quickly.

sam: rollback criteria: if p95 > 300ms or error rate > 2% sustained for 5 minutes after pin, full rollback to v3.4.8 on all regions. Timeline: apply pin now, evaluate 5m, escalate if failure.

maya: executing pin config change now. Will keep the main rollout paused for eu1 and continue global rollout for other regions.

deploy-bot: Route update: eu1 traffic gated -> pinned to v3.4.8 (legacy-quant). Global rollout paused for eu1.

maya: run this quick smoke locally after the pin (200 concurrent requests):
```
for i in {1..200}; do 
  curl -sS -X POST https://eu1.api.redwood.internal/v1/embeddings \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
    -d '{"model":"embed-3.4.8","input":"smoke payload"}' &
 done; wait
```

qa-runner-bot: starting synthetic battery against pinned variant now. Will post p50/p95/error numbers.

qa-runner-bot: Synthetic results: p50 45ms, p95 120ms, error rate 0.6% (within baseline). KV-cache warmup observed but not impacting p95.

sam: traces look healthy post-pin. Kernel mismatch hypothesis holds — inference-proxy hit unexpected EOF under q5_small path on kernel X. I'll file an infra + runtime ticket.

alejandro: filing perf ticket and assigning to runtime and infra. Link: https://issues.redwood.internal/INFR-4567 — includes trace snippets, coredumps, and failed request IDs.

maya: plan: keep eu1 pinned for 2 hours while infra rolls back driver on affected nodes or runtime team cuts a quant-fix. Will unpause eu1 rollout only when sig-runtime + sig-qa sign off. Change window noted. :calendar:

sam: noted. Also adding a release note blurb for 3.5.0: "temporarily disabled q5_small embed variant in eu1 due to post-deploy perf regression; regional pin applied — investigating."

deploy-bot: Note: automated monitor set: alert if eu1 p95 > 300ms or errors > 2% for 5 consecutive mins.

deploy-bot: Thread closed by automation after regional pin applied and monitors configured.
